diagram_note: Named KPI lists copied from src/gunnchos_7gc_verticals. These are reference names, not measured health, energy, or vehicle trials.

rows.ethical_framing: health_kpis returns latency_emergency, device_battery, and privacy_mode. No numeric health trial is stored.
energy_kpis returns solar_uptime and backhaul_availability. No numeric energy trial is stored.
vehicle_kpis returns v2x_latency and school_zone_alert_rate. No numeric vehicle trial is stored.
map_to_repos sends health to 7gc-digital-twin and energy to edge-io-measurement-node. Other names fall back to 7gc-digital-twin.
SCENARIO_FIELDS lists vertical, site_id, kpis, and constraints. No filled scenario file with measurements is in this repository.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # 7GC Verticals 6G Use-Case Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: Health, energy, vehicles, industry/defense KPI mappings for 7GC campuses.

sections.title: Commands
sections.body: make install && make test && make e2e

methods: Methods are the KPI name lists in src/gunnchos_7gc_verticals for health, energy, vehicles, and industry. The files name the indicators. They do not store measured vertical trials.
